text:
Maria: Quick thread — post-launch backlog sync. Launch is stable for the last 48h. Need a decision for the next 2-week slice. Candidates:
- streaming regression (customers reporting garbled output)
- prompt editor UX polish (several requests from pilot customers)
- embed cache warming (infra cost saving)
Any strong opinions on order and scope?

Rahul: Streaming regression should be first. It's reproducible for 4 paying customers and blocks their workflows. Hotfix path seems feasible.

Ethan: +1 on bug first. If the fix needs infra changes that take >3 days, we should run a small UX polish in parallel (2 devs) so we still deliver value.

Sasha: The prompt editor asks are mostly quick wins (placeholder text, save state) and reduce support noise. If Rahul's team can take 60% focus, we can allocate a couple of dev-days for UX. :thinking_face:

Dalia: Embed cache warming is important but medium ROI short-term. My vote: low priority this sprint unless we see a cost spike. Suggest a lightweight scoring to break ties:
```
priority scoring (effort, impact, risk)
streaming bug: 2, 9, 3 -> score 14
prompt editor: 3, 6, 2 -> score 11
embed warming: 4, 5, 2 -> score 11
```
(we weight impact higher)

triage-bot: Auto-priority summary generated: streaming-regression=9/10, prompt-editor=6/10, embed-cache=5/10. See /triage/heatmap/1712349999

Maria: Proposed plan: sprint A (2 weeks)
- Allocate ~60% of ekg/dev capacity to streaming regression (owner: Rahul + 1)
- 20% to prompt editor quick wins (Ethan)
- 20% to monitoring/runbook + customer comms (Sasha)
Fallback: if streaming fix blocked >72h, pivot 40% capacity to UX polish. Can we commit to that? :thumbsup:

Ethan: I can commit to delivery on the UX polish: 3 days for quick wins + design pass. Will open PRs early for review.

Sasha: I'll own alerts and the runbook. Will add a dedicated alert channel (#inc-streaming) and prepare a one-paragraph customer comms template.

Rahul: Sounds good. I'll scope the bug, identify blockers, and post a short plan by EOD. If it's infra-blocked, we flip to the fallback.

Dalia: Agree. Add a follow-up milestone: measure support ticket volume and latency delta for 2 weeks post-fix. Also capture CPU/GPU token cost for the embed path in the retrospective.

Maria: Great — committing this as the sprint charter. I'll update the roadmap board and tag owners. Meeting-lite: we'll do a 15m sync on day 3 if the bug is still open.

Rahul: :thumbsup: thanks all.

Sasha: Adding runbook template now.

(END)
